## Package Submission

- **Package Name:** `<name>`
- **Repository URL:** `https://github.com<user>/<repo>`
- **Short Description:** What does this library do?

### Checklist
- [ ] File name contains only `a-z`, `A-Z`, `0-9`, `-`, `_` (no `.txt` or other extensions).
- [ ] The file contains only a single line with a direct `https://` link to a `.zip` archive.
- [ ] The archive contains source code only (no `.exe`, `.dll`, `.bat`, `.ps1` binaries).
- [ ] Tested locally with `bpm install <package-name>`.
